gloss: with dignity, in a stately manner

definitions.gloss: with dignity, in a stately and composed manner
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who carries themselves with an air of dignity, poise, and inner strength. Can also describe a crisp, bracing quality in the air.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{凛|りん}と⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
{凛|りん}と⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{張|は}り{詰|つ}めて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The air was crisp and tense.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直面|ちょくめん}して→直面する：15862_chokumensuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{凛|りん}と⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}さなかった→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧。
examples.english: Even when facing difficulties, she did not lose her dignified composure.

notes:
An adverb formed from the mimetic base {凛|りん} + the quotative particle ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧. Evokes a sense of composed strength, elegance, and sharpness.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {凛|りん}と⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧ (to carry oneself with dignity)
- {凛|りん}と⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ + noun (dignified, composed ~)
- {凛|りん}と⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧ (dignified figure)
- {凛|りん}と⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (poised attitude)
- {凛|りん}と⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧ (composed expression)
- {凛|りん}と⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧ (crisp air)

USAGE:
Most commonly used to describe women who project quiet strength and composure, though it can describe anyone. When describing air or atmosphere, it conveys a sharp, bracing quality. The kanji {凛|りん} is also popular in girls' names ({凛|りん}, {凛子|りんこ}).
